The background blur is acceptable, but the edge definition on the scutes is slightly soft. Compared to Reference 2 (mid-quality hammerhead with structural issues), this image is far superior structurally but shares some textural artificiality. It scores higher than Ref 2 but lower than Ref 3 (which had better texture despite being a bird).
